name: freeup-space
description: Review cleanup opportunities on macOS and Windows with Quick Scan, Deep Scan, or Deep Scan + AI.

interface.shortDescription: Scan, select items and confirm cleanup in a widget.
interface.longDescription: Choose Quick Scan, Deep Scan or Deep Scan + AI. Review disposable clutter, verified extra copies, older versions with a keep-latest recommendation, inactive files and large personal files. Select recommended items across the saved scan, preview exact files and confirm recoverable moves to Trash or Recycle Bin.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open Freeup Space so I can choose a scan, review categories and select items to move to Trash.
